_comment: Reviewed security audit exceptions. Each entry documents a known high/critical vulnerability that has been assessed and accepted with mitigations in place. scripts/check-audit-exceptions.js fails CI when an entry's reviewDate has passed. Review quarterly or when upgrading major dependencies.
_history: 2026-09-24: GHSA-9g9p-9gw9-jx7f and GHSA-h25m-26qc-wcjf (next) resolved by upgrading Next.js 14.2.35 -> 15.5.26 (Maintenance LTS); both entries removed.
2026-09-24: axios, form-data, nanoid, qs fixed by npm audit fix; nodemailer 7 -> 10.

accepted.mitigation: PostCSS runs only at build time, on the application's own CSS (Tailwind); no attacker-controlled CSS or source maps are processed and PostCSS is not reachable at runtime. The fix requires next@16 (major).
accepted.fixAvailable: next@16.x (breaking change; planned after the Next.js 15 upgrade)
